userStories.title: Browse markdown files with folder navigation
Create new markdown document in specified folder
View document list with folder hierarchy
Automatic GitHub commits with conflict handling
Implement GitHub service layer with Octokit
Update user presence with GitHub avatars
Sidebar commenting system for document collaboration
Reply to comments in thread
acceptanceCriteria: User can click 'Reply' on any existing comment
Reply input field appears below the comment
User can type and submit a reply
Reply is displayed indented below the parent comment
Replies show user avatar, name, and timestamp
Replies are stored in database with parent_id reference
Real-time updates show new replies to other users
Validation prevents nesting deeper than 1 level (replies to replies become replies to parent)

userStories.title: Resolve comments and hide from view
acceptanceCriteria: User can click 'Resolve' button on a comment thread
Entire thread (parent + replies) is marked as resolved in database
Resolved threads are hidden from default view
Resolved threads appear with different visual style (dimmed/checked)
User can 'Unresolve' a thread to bring it back
